_: Onething's texts. morning / reminder / kept: one picked at random per send (src/lib/onething/core.ts). buddy: fixed templates for the buddy-streak lines (src/lib/onething/buddies.ts). retired: wordings no longer sent, kept only so their late echoes are still recognised. The register is reflection, not a writing task: every morning and evening line turns the person back to their day — one thing that happened, one observation — and never says 'write a sentence'. Quiet, specific, no exclamation marks, no verdict on what the person wrote. {n} is a streak day, {points} a number, {name} / {names} / {in} / {out} are people. Every outbound text starts with one of these lines (extra lines follow, the site URL last), and looksLikeOurs() matches inbound text against this file to keep our own echoes from being saved as thoughts — so add lines here, never inline in code, and move a line to retired rather than deleting it.
